newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - STG STRUGGLES TO RECOVER, EYES 3.03 MARKS.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - STG STRUGGLES TO RECOVER, EYES 3.03 MARKS.

text.p: Sterling will struggle to recover above 3.03 marks and $1.61 in Europe after crumbling to around 3.0 marks and five-month lows below $1.60 on Wednesday, said chartists.
"Sterling/mark seems to be making a small correction after the downmove we had yesterday," said Dominique Corombelle, technical analyst at Generale Bank in Brussels.
At 0840 GMT, sterling/mark was trading at 3.0185/90 against 3.0130 in late Europe on Wednesday. Cable was trading at $1.6005 against $1.6038 in late Europe.
Analysts, however, said sterling remains vulnerable.
Chartists said while the pound would struggle to recover, it remains vulnerable on the charts after ripping through a series of support levels.
Corombelle said before sterling/mark attacked the 3.03-mark barrier it would have to regain its footing around 3.0125/30 marks -- a pivot for most of July.

Corombelle said the 3.0125/30-mark level needs to hold if the pair is to attempt to recover some of its losses. "I think we have seen the top for sterling/mark. The first was 3.08 marks, the next at 3.06 and now we are correcting before the next downleg," he added.
